context:
Goal: a lane's review findings ride in its own PR, as you picked on item 386 b, not in a stream of follow-up PRs.
Problem (rule): filing a finding after the last review round moves the PR's head, so its review record goes stale. Today no push is allowed after a done record.
Based on (ruling): your item 386 b, 22:25 CST Nov 7.
Based on (read): decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3: a fix check covers only a fix to a round's defect.
Departs from: decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3, where a fix check covers only a round's defect fix — it also covers a diff that only adds the round's findings to the debt store or the notes file.
Meanwhile: lane findings-ride-in-lane builds the parts both options share; the fix-check part waits.

options.gain: Findings ride in the lane's own PR, with no second PR.
options.how: A short fix check passes a push whose diff only adds the round's findings to the debt store or the notes file. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Allow it
options.lose: The shared fix check accepts a wider set of pushes, and each lane uses one more fix check.

options.gain: No change to the decision or to the shared fix check.
options.how: The lane's PR keeps its reviewed head. Its findings go in one docs PR per topic.
options.label: Findings go to one follow-up docs PR per topic (recommended)
options.lose: Each lane with findings opens one more PR.
